note: One habit against the pieces the first reading left. The label is `moves|situations`: the pieces that should yield a verbatim quote making the move, and those that should yield one in the habit's situation (none when the habit names no situation), each sorted and joined by +. Every cell becomes a count (core/compiler/moves.ts inferMoves), so a false move here raises a rate and a false situation moves the 2×2. v1 live on claude-haiku-5-5, 2026-10-19: 25/30; the one failure took a situation present (input from the query string unchecked) for the move made, 5 of 5, and found the situation nowhere; v2 says the situation present is not the move made. v3 (2026-10-19) tells the reading each habit's modality and that a finding on topic is not the move; four hard negatives modelled on the over-counts seen on the real persona (severity, consistency, concession) and one whole-piece habit. The `real-*` cases read the public code-review corpus (bench/standing/domains/code-review/examples, twelve pieces) with labels set by hand from the pieces on 2026-10-19; they are the cases that failed on the real build. v3 live on the real cases (2026-10-19): the all-twelve habits read 12 of 12 five times of five (demand for tests, mechanism-consequence, neutral openings), severity 7+9 (+3), consistency 2+5; the under-counts are on concessions made in suggestions, hedged instructions, and whole-piece judgements, which v4 addresses in words.
